text_en: In the year that the commander-in-chief, who was sent by King Sargon of Assyria, came to Ashdod and fought against it and took it—
text_cn: 亚述王撒尔贡派遣总司令来到阿市多得，进攻克服阿市多得的那一年 ──

text_en: at that time the Lord had spoken to Isaiah son of Amoz, saying, “Go, and loose the sackcloth from your loins and take your sandals off your feet, ” and he had done so, walking naked and barefoot.
text_cn: 那时上主曾藉阿摩兹的儿子依撒意亚发言说：“去！脱下你腰间的苦衣，除去你脚上的鞋！”他就这样作了，裸体赤足而行──

text_en: Then the Lord said, “Just as my servant Isaiah has walked naked and barefoot for three years as a sign and a portent against Egypt and Ethiopia,
text_cn: 上主说：“就如我的仆人依撒意亚，三年之久，裸体赤足而行，为埃及和雇士是一个预言和先兆；

text_en: so shall the king of Assyria lead away the Egyptians as captives and the Ethiopians as exiles, both the young and the old, naked and barefoot, with buttocks uncovered, to the shame of Egypt.
text_cn: 同样亚述王要将埃及的俘虏和雇士的流徒带走，无论老幼，一律裸体赤足，露着下体，好羞辱埃及。”

text_en: And they shall be dismayed and confounded because of Ethiopia their hope and of Egypt their boast.
text_cn: 人们将对他们的仰望雇士，对他们的光荣埃及，感到失望和羞惭。

text_en: In that day the inhabitants of this coastland will say, ‘See, this is what has happened to those in whom we hoped and to whom we fled for help and deliverance from the king of Assyria! And we, how shall we escape? ’”
text_cn: 这一带海滨的居民，在那天要说：“看！这原是我们所依赖，跑去求救，藉以摆脱亚述王的人！我们又怎能逃避呢？”
